title: Office Clerks, General
description: Perform duties too varied and diverse to be classified in any specific office clerical occupation, requiring knowledge of office systems and procedures. Clerical duties may be assigned in accordance with the office procedures of individual establishments and may include a combination of answering telephones, bookkeeping, typing or word processing, office machine operation, and filing.

tasks.text: Operate office machines, such as photocopiers and scanners, facsimile machines, voice mail systems, and personal computers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical operation of office machines and jams

tasks.text: Answer telephones, direct calls, and take messages.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Call routing automatable; nuanced calls need human

dwas.name: Answer telephones to direct calls or provide information.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Communicate with customers, employees, and other individuals to answer questions, disseminate or explain information, take orders, and address complaints.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Drafting responses easy; live de-escalation is human

dwas.name: Confer with coworkers to coordinate work activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

dwas.name: Respond to customer problems or complaints.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Maintain and update filing, inventory, mailing, and database systems, either manually or using a computer.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain inventory records from provided counts

tasks.text: Compile, copy, sort, and file records of office activities, business transactions, and other activities.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Compiling data or documentation is largely automatable

tasks.text: Review files, records, and other documents to obtain information to respond to requests.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Search files and references for info

dwas.name: Search files, databases or reference materials to obtain needed information.

tasks.text: Open, sort, and route incoming mail, answer correspondence, and prepare outgoing mail.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sorting and delivering physical mail

tasks.text: Compute, record, and proofread data and other information, such as records or reports.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Detecting recording errors is deterministic pattern matching

dwas.name: Proofread documents, records, or other files to ensure accuracy.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Complete work schedules, manage calendars, and arrange appointments.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Calendar scheduling automatable; exceptions need human judgment

dwas.name: Prepare employee work schedules.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Type, format, proofread, and edit correspondence and other documents, from notes or dictating machines, using computers or typewriters.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Proofreading text for accuracy is core LLM strength

dwas.name: Proofread documents, records, or other files to ensure accuracy.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Inventory and order materials, supplies, and services.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — System inventory monitoring automatable; physical audit human

dwas.name: Monitor inventories of products or materials.

tasks.text: Deliver messages and run errands.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Providing routine information to coworkers is text-based

dwas.name: Provide information to coworkers.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Collect, count, and disburse money, do basic bookkeeping, and complete banking transactions.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Financial execution software-mediated; authorization human

dwas.name: Prepare cash for deposit or disbursement.
Execute sales or other financial transactions.

tasks.text: Complete and mail bills, contracts, policies, invoices, or checks.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Sending digital materials automatable; physical mailing human

tasks.text: Process and prepare documents, such as business or government forms and expense reports.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Compliance docs drafted; human owns regulatory accuracy

dwas.name: Prepare documentation for contracts, transactions, or regulatory compliance.

tasks.text: Monitor and direct the work of lower-level clerks.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Supervising clerical staff is relational management work

tasks.text: Prepare meeting agendas, attend meetings, and record and transcribe minutes.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Transcribe spoken or written information accurately

dwas.name: Record information from meetings or other formal proceedings.

tasks.text: Train other staff members to perform work activities, such as using computer applications.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — General personnel training is human-led and relational

tasks.text: Count, weigh, measure, or organize materials.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Weight/volume calculations from given data

dwas.name: Calculate weights, volumes or other characteristics of materials.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Troubleshoot problems involving office equipment, such as computer hardware and software.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical office equipment servicing

dwas.name: Maintain office equipment in proper operating condition.
